title: A sublattice dimensionality index: code and computed results
description: Code and computed results behind 'A sublattice dimensionality index validated against deposited halides and chalcogenides'. Contains the reference implementation of the index, the database-scale indexer, every script that produced a number in the paper, and the computed indices for 703 metal halides and 158 metal chalcogenides carrying author-stated dimensionality labels, together with the stoichiometric baseline, the whole-network comparison, the two copper-halide database screens, the sensitivity sweep over the candidate search radius and the throughput measurements. Structures are identified by Crystallography Open Database entry number rather than redistributed. Version 2 rebuilds the record from the sources behind the submitted manuscript: it adds reindex_allmetal.py and its 703-row output, the 3,512-row hybrid screen and both screening scripts, the R_next sweep and the rank-stratified analysis of the fractional term, and a manifest with SHA-256 hashes. MATLAB plotting scripts included in version 1 in error are withdrawn; they are part of an internal library that is not distributed, and every value they draw remains in the JSON files here.
